blinding_guess.why: The packet pairs old-location params (/move_group/allowed_execution_duration_scaling, /move_group/allowed_goal_duration_margin) with new-location ones under trajectory_execution/. The code reads the old names in initialize() (cpp:132-140, deprecation warning) and only afterwards constructs the dynamic_reconfigure server on ~/trajectory_execution (cpp:192, via DynamicReconfigureImpl ctor at cpp:58-62), whose setCallback applies the reconfigure config (cfg defaults 1.1 / 0.5 when the new params are unset) through setAllowedExecutionDurationScaling/setAllowedGoalDurationMargin (cpp:69-70). I believe this silently overwrites any value supplied at the deprecated location, so the old params are warned about but not honoured. This relies on dynamic_reconfigure's documented setCallback behaviour, not verified from the snapshot.

notes: ROS 1 (indigo) package; all seven packet elements are parameters that moveit_ros_planning's TrajectoryExecutionManager declares. The code names them relative to the private namespace: NodeHandle("~") for moveit_manage_controllers, moveit_controller_manager, allowed_execution_duration_scaling, allowed_goal_duration_margin (the last two are deprecated old locations read with a warning 'parameter moved into namespace trajectory_execution'), and NodeHandle("~/trajectory_execution") dynamic_reconfigure server for the TrajectoryExecutionDynamicReconfigure.cfg params. The literal '/move_group' prefix is not written in this package; it comes from the host node name (move_group node in moveit_ros_move_group, same snapshot). declares uses the packet's canonical names. moveit_manage_controllers is read only by the constructors without an explicit manage_controllers argument (cpp:88); the other constructor takes it as an argument (cpp:103).
